mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days because it indicates an accommodative monetary policy that supports equity valuations.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or the positive return rate for FEDFUNDS < 4.0% is less than 55%.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 4.5% signals a tightening monetary cycle that reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in < 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) declines and unemployment rate (UNRATE) rises, it signals an economic slowdown that leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO decline > 0.5% in 3 months AND UNRATE rise > 0.3pp in 3 months
failure_condition: The interaction condition (INDPRO decline > 0.5% and UNRATE rise > 0.3pp in 3 months) occurs in more than 30% of cases without producing negative returns (i.e., returns are positive in > 30% of such cases), or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion (defined by INDPRO > 110 and UNRATE < 4.5%), a rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 0.3pp in 3 months predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days because it signals the onset of a recession.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO > 110 AND UNRATE < 4.5% AND UNRATE rise > 0.3pp in 3 months
failure_condition: The regime condition (INDPRO > 110 and UNRATE < 4.5%) and UNRATE rise > 0.3pp in 3 months occur in more than 30% of cases without producing negative returns (i.e., returns are positive in > 30% of such cases), or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in residential fixed investment (RSAFS) of more than 5% in the past 3 months predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days because it signals a shift to more defensive consumption patterns that support equity valuations.
failure_condition: RSAFS decline > 5% in 3 months occurs in more than 30% of cases without producing positive returns (i.e., returns are negative in > 30% of such cases), or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A lower unemployment rate (UNRATE) predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days because it indicates a strong labor market that supports consumer spending and corporate earnings growth.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or the positive return rate for UNRATE < 4.5% is less than 55%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) above 3.0% annually predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days because it signals an inflationary environment that leads to monetary tightening and reduced equity valuations.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL > 3.0% annualized occurs in more than 30% of cases without producing negative returns (i.e., returns are positive in > 30% of such cases), or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in industrial production (INDPRO) of more than 1% in the past 1 month predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days because it signals an immediate economic shock that increases risk aversion and leads to equity sell-offs.
failure_condition: INDPRO decline > 1% in 1 month occurs in more than 30% of cases without producing negative returns (i.e., returns are positive in > 30% of such cases), or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
